blocks.text: Cloverdale Detached Homes Over $1.8M — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: What types of properties are listed over $1.8M in Cloverdale?
Above $1.8M,
Cloverdale

inventory consists of newly constructed 3,800 to 5,500+ sq ft three-level custom homes on 6,500–12,000 sq ft urban lots, large detached homes backing onto Northview Golf & Country Club or Sunrise Golf Course, and 1- to 10-acre rural and Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) parcels.
What are the house size limits on ALR land in Cloverdale?

Properties inside the provincial Agricultural Land Reserve in West Cloverdale and the Serpentine flats follow ALC residential footprint rules, which generally cap the principal residence at 500 m² (5,382 sq ft) of total floor area plus a permitted 90 m² (969 sq ft) secondary residence, subject to City of Surrey A-1 / A-2 zoning. Do Cloverdale homes over $1.8M have municipal sewer or septic systems?

Custom homes inside Cloverdale's urban residential subdivisions connect to municipal water, sanitary sewer, and storm mains. Rural acreages west of 168 Street or south of Highway 10 typically use private septic fields (sometimes paired with municipal water or drilled wells) and require a certified septic inspection during due diligence.
Are legal two-bedroom basement suites common in newer Cloverdale custom homes?

Yes. Most recent 3-level custom builds over $1.8M in Cloverdale are designed with a legal 2-bedroom secondary suite plus an additional media room or bedroom for upstairs use, and larger RF-zoned or suburban lots may also qualify for detached accessory buildings.
How does BC Property Transfer Tax apply to homes over $1.8M?

British Columbia Property Transfer Tax is calculated at 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion between $200,000 and $2,000,000, 3% on the portion between $2,000,000 and $3,000,000, and 5% on the residential portion above $3,000,000 (with different rules for classified farm land).
What flood-construction or soil factors apply to West Cloverdale acreages?

Low-lying parcels in the Serpentine and Nicomekl river floodplains fall within designated City of Surrey floodplain areas, which establish minimum Flood Construction Levels (FCL) and geotechnical fill requirements for new foundations and outbuildings.
How do Cloverdale homes over $1.8M compare with South Surrey homes over $1.8M?
South Surrey homes over $1.8M

focus on Elgin Chantrell, Morgan Creek, Grandview Heights, and Sunnyside Park, whereas Cloverdale over $1.8M often provides larger lot square footage or agricultural acreage at a lower price per acre.
